title: Identity stalk computation for algebraically closed étale sheaves
statement: For an algebraically closed field Ω and a sheaf G of sets on Spec Ω, the map from sections on the identity étale object to the identity geometric stalk is bijective.

proof.text: The marked lift gives a morphism from the identity neighbourhood to every pointed neighbourhood. Equality of germs is tested on a refinement and pulled back along its marked lift, whose composite with the refinement map is the identity. Every germ has a neighbourhood representative; restricting along its marked lift yields a global representative with the same germ by colimit naturality.

proof_origin.place: geometric stalk construction preceding Tag 03Q1; direct identity-neighbourhood proof

theorem spec_algClosed_etale_sheaf_constant_stalk
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (G : Sheaf ((Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).smallEtaleTopology) (Type (u + 1))) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        (Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))))
        (Over.homMk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)))
          (Category.comp_id (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))))) G.obj)
